terms.comment: Originally a fishpond, a bathing pool from the first century AD, as in Pliny’s heated pool.

phrases.latin: cohaeret calida piscīna mīrifica, ex quā natantēs mare aspiciunt
phrases.english: next to it is a wonderful heated pool, from which swimmers look out at the sea

sources: Lewis & Short: piscina
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. swimming pool. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 50.
Pliny checked against the Perseus Latin texts and the Latinitas loci collections.
